response.justification: Bogdan has strong geospatial/navigation domain expertise through GISCollective and Green Map, plus proven ability to build high-performance distributed systems (Dunnhumby media: millions of requests/second, low-latency optimization). His demonstrated versatility and problem-solving approach align well with the role's requirements for expanding across the full technical stack. However, his most substantial C++ work dates back 11 years to National Instruments; his recent decade has focused on TypeScript/Node.js/web technologies. While his ability to quickly master multiple languages suggests he could effectively ramp up on modern C++, the significant gap in the primary required technology presents meaningful risk.
strengths: Deep geospatial and routing domain knowledge from GISCollective and Green Map projects with proven ability to build systems serving multiple users at scale
Extensive high-performance distributed systems experience including asynchronous I/O, caching, fibers, and real-time metadata processing from Dunnhumby media
Senior-level capability with demonstrated expertise in testing, TDD, problem-solving methodology, and ability to master multiple programming languages
concerns: Most recent substantial C++ experience was 11 years ago (National Instruments 2014-2015); primary recent languages are TypeScript and JavaScript in web/product contexts
No Rust experience demonstrated, despite being listed as acceptable alternative to C++
Career trajectory focused on web/product engineering and high-level languages rather than systems-level C++ or infrastructure development
